summary: A primary action, in six variants, three sizes and three shapes, with optional loading and icon-only states.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight. `primary` for the main action on a view, `danger` for destructive ones.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth. `inset` reads as a pressed control, `outset` as a raised one.

props.name: loading
props.description: Dims the button and blocks interaction. Sets `aria-busy` rather than `disabled`, because to a screen reader a busy control is not an unavailable one.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Equal padding on both axes, for a button whose only child is an icon. Pair it with an `aria-label`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the button.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended after the generated classes, so any Yumma CSS utility you pass wins.
